newsitem.title: POLAND: Stomil Sanok seen up after strong debut.
newsitem.headline: Stomil Sanok seen up after strong debut.

text.p: Polish rubber producer Stomil Sanok SA, which started trade on Thursday 120 percent above its issue price in heavy 16-million-zloty trade, should extend gains on Friday, analysts said.
The stock opened at 55 zlotys compared to its offer price of 25 zlotys.
"At the new price Sanok's price to earnings ratio is a little over 19, compared to the 29 and 32 before today's session of (tyre makers) Stomil Olsztyn and Debica," one trader said.
Analysts said the stronger buying after price-fixing signalled gains for Sanok on Friday, an expectation shared by the firm's president.

"Today's price allows investors to hope that the value of the firm will grow in the future, and raising that value is management's main task," Marek Lecki told a news conference at the bourse after the day's session.
